accounting_framework: IFRS (FSA-regulated; IFRS for SMEs permitted for qualifying small entities since the FSA's February 2025 decision). MSX-listed ESG reporting mandatory from 2025; full IFRS S1/S2 by 2029.

default_tax_line.label: Taxes
default_tax_line.basis: Standard CIT 15% of taxable income (all companies incl. foreign-owned).

tax_recipes.sme_3pct: 3% rate for qualifying SMEs: registered capital <= OMR 60,000 at the start of the tax year, gross income <= OMR 150,000, average employees <= 25 (simplified 3-month filing). Set tax_pct_ebt = 0.03 and disclose.
tax_recipes.pillar_two: DMTT 15% for FYs from 1 Jan 2025, groups >= EUR 750m (2-of-4 test): default rate already 15%, so usually no adjustment.

vat_note: VAT 5% since April 2021. AR/AP balances may be VAT-inclusive.
fiscal_year_note: Calendar year default (any 12-month year permitted). OMR pegged at USD 2.6008 per OMR (~OMR 0.3845/USD); amounts quoted to 3 decimals (baisa).
depreciation_note: Tax depreciation: buildings 4% SL (doubled for industrial use; prefabricated 15%); pooled declining-balance groups - plant/machinery/vehicles 15%, computers/heavy equipment 33.33%.
pillar_two_note: DMTT in force from FY2025 for large MNE groups.
disclosure: Tax modeled as 15% of earnings before tax (Oman standard CIT); the 3% SME regime and the DMTT are available as explicit overrides. Not tax advice. Statements per IFRS.
